bootstrap.multiplicity: Descriptive marginal intervals; no familywise significance claim.

completion_gate: Exactly four arms per frozen seed and verified terminal cloud reconciliation plus no active ledger reservation; otherwise incomplete.
configuration_repeat_summary: Arithmetic mean and observed minimum/maximum across measured repeats; range is not a confidence interval.
existing_comparisons: Retain existing fixed-compute comparison intervals verbatim with original method metadata; separately label these preregistered additional contrasts.
pairing: Exact question_id and sampling_seed matches across four arms; average seeds within each question before resampling question clusters. Entire frozen cohort retained.
search_cost: Clone derived trial cost with the unique matching cloud-overhead-roundNN-METHOD finish event added once. Shared setup and unassigned allocation remain separate. Raw records immutable.
